Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Complete Dynamic Query Builder Integration - Replace FacetedFilters with QueryBuilder

## Summary
Completed the integration of the Dynamic Query Builder into the search interface, replacing the old FacetedFilters panel. Users can now construct sophisticated filter conditions using a tree-based UI that supports And/Or logic, field-based filtering, and metadata search.

## Changes

### Server Functions
- Added `SearchDocumentsDynamic` server function in src/web_app/components/search.rs
  - Accepts `DynamicQueryRequest` with optional query and structured FilterCondition
  - Compiles FilterCondition to SQL WHERE clause using QueryCompiler
  - Calls `db::dynamic_search\(\)` with compiled filters and text query
  - Supports both text search and metadata-only filtering

### Frontend Integration  
- Updated src/web_app/pages/search.rs
  - Removed imports: FacetedFilters component and get_categories function
  - Added imports: QueryBuilder component and FilterCondition type
  - Replaced individual filter state signals \(category, keywords, concepts, etc.\) with single `query_filter` signal
  - Changed ServerAction from SearchDocuments to SearchDocumentsDynamic
  - Updated execute_search to use DynamicQueryRequest instead of SearchRequest
  - Replaced FacetedFilters UI panel with QueryBuilder component
  - QueryBuilder now takes filter_change callback that triggers search on filter updates

### Bug Fixes
- Removed tokio::time::sleep imports from src/web_app/components/query_builder.rs \(not available in WASM\)
- Removed async sleep call from blur handler, replaced with direct state update
- Fixed undefined variable in src/web_app/components/chat.rs \(conversation_id → selected_conversation_id\)

## Features
- Users can now build complex filter conditions using the QueryBuilder UI
- Supports searching metadata fields: keywords, locations, persons, organizations, events, etc.
- Filters compile to efficient SQL WHERE clauses using metadata JSONB operations
- Filter-only search enabled \(no text query required to use filters\)
- Full text search with filters combined seamlessly

## Testing
- All 235 unit tests pass
- Frontend compiles to WASM without errors
- SearchDocumentsDynamic function properly wired and callable from frontend

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
